title: Separate measured-law norm control from rare-pin likelihood control
statement: For Hermitian X=2^-s A and any complete POVM, sum_y |Tr(M_y X)|<=||X||1<=||A||_(2,tau). Unconditioned measurement avoids an exponential support penalty. A normalized rank-one pin Q=2^s|y><y| instead has |tau(AQ)|<=2^(s/2)||A||_(2,tau); the former bound is not a uniform relative likelihood estimate for rare outcomes.
